title: 字符串连接删减字母
summary: 按给定顺序处理单词，每个新词可放在当前字符串前或后，连接处相同字符可重叠一个，求最终最短长度。
insight: 后续决策只关心当前字符串的首字符、尾字符和最短长度。对每个新词分别尝试追加与前置，连接边界字符相同时少增加一位，形成二十六乘二十六的动态规划。
pitfalls: 单词处理顺序不能改变
每个新词只能放在整体前端或后端
重叠只发生在一个连接边界字符
状态保存首尾字符而非完整字符串

solutions.title: 按当前首尾字符动态规划
solutions.idea: 每个单词用前置和追加两种方式转移首尾状态。
steps: 依次处理后续单词，建立全无穷 next
对每个可达 first,last 状态
追加：增加 len-(last==word.first)，新尾为 word.last
前置：增加 len-(word.last==first)，新首为 word.first
取 next 全状态最小值

code.java: class Solution { public int minimizeConcatenatedLength(String[] words){int inf=1000000000;int[][] dp=new int[26][26];for(int[] row:dp)Arrays.fill(row,inf);String firstWord=words[0];dp[firstWord.charAt(0)-'a'][firstWord.charAt(firstWord.length()-1)-'a']=firstWord.length();for(int index=1;index<words.length;index++){String word=words[index];int a=word.charAt(0)-'a',b=word.charAt(word.length()-1)-'a',length=word.length();int[][] next=new int[26][26];for(int[] row:next)Arrays.fill(row,inf);for(int first=0;first<26;first++)for(int last=0;last<26;last++)if(dp[first][last]<inf){next[first][b]=Math.min(next[first][b],dp[first][last]+length-(last==a?1:0));next[a][last]=Math.min(next[a][last],dp[first][last]+length-(b==first?1:0));}dp=next;}int answer=inf;for(int[] row:dp)for(int value:row)answer=Math.min(answer,value);return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minimizeConcatenatedLength(words:Array<String>):Int{val inf=1000000000;var dp=Array(26){IntArray(26){inf}};val firstWord=words[0];dp[firstWord.first()-'a'][firstWord.last()-'a']=firstWord.length;for(index in 1 until words.size){val word=words[index];val a=word.first()-'a';val b=word.last()-'a';val length=word.length;val next=Array(26){IntArray(26){inf}};for(first in 0 until 26)for(last in 0 until 26)if(dp[first][last]<inf){next[first][b]=minOf(next[first][b],dp[first][last]+length-if(last==a)1 else 0);next[a][last]=minOf(next[a][last],dp[first][last]+length-if(b==first)1 else 0)};dp=next};var answer=inf;for(row in dp)for(value in row)answer=minOf(answer,value);return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int minimizeConcatenatedLength(vector<string>& words){const int INF=1000000000;vector dp(26,vector<int>(26,INF));dp[words[0].front()-'a'][words[0].back()-'a']=words[0].size();for(int index=1;index<(int)words.size();++index){int a=words[index].front()-'a',b=words[index].back()-'a',length=words[index].size();vector next(26,vector<int>(26,INF));for(int first=0;first<26;++first)for(int last=0;last<26;++last)if(dp[first][last]<INF){next[first][b]=min(next[first][b],dp[first][last]+length-(last==a));next[a][last]=min(next[a][last],dp[first][last]+length-(b==first));}dp=move(next);}int answer=INF;for(auto& row:dp)for(int value:row)answer=min(answer,value);return answer;} };
